views_sql.peptidoforms_1pct: CREATE VIEW peptidoforms_1pct AS SELECT * FROM peptidoforms WHERE ((target_decoy = 'target') AND (best_q_value <= 0.01) AND ((best_q_value_notch IS NULL) OR (best_q_value_notch <= 0.01)));
views_sql.protein_groups_1pct: CREATE VIEW protein_groups_1pct AS SELECT * FROM protein_groups WHERE ((target_decoy != 'decoy') AND (q_value <= 0.01));
views_sql.psms_1pct: CREATE VIEW psms_1pct AS SELECT * FROM psms WHERE ((target_decoy = 'target') AND (q_value <= 0.01) AND ((q_value_notch IS NULL) OR (q_value_notch <= 0.01)) AND (COALESCE(notch_ambiguous, CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)) = CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)));
views_sql.ptm_sites_by_chemistry: CREATE VIEW ptm_sites_by_chemistry AS SELECT dataset_id, protein_accession, "position", residue, modification, COALESCE(modification, modification_name) AS chemistry_key, count_star() AS n_names, list(DISTINCT modification_name) AS modification_names, sum(n_psms) AS n_psms, min(best_q_value) AS best_q_value, min(best_ambiguity_level) AS best_ambiguity_level, max(target_decoy) AS target_decoy FROM ptm_sites GROUP BY dataset_id, protein_accession, "position", residue, modification, chemistry_key;
